integrity: The proof uses Fang's published square and parity theorems plus an exact abundancy-factor inequality and a standard 2-adic LTE computation. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a necessary structural condition for nonsquare almost superperfect integers; it neither proves existence nor treats the square branch.
title: A 2-adic least-prime barrier for nonsquare almost superperfect numbers
